text:
Sasha Ivanov: Starting staged rollout for v4.0.0 -> canary segments: ap-south 8%, us-west 4%. Change window tonight 01:00-04:00 UTC. Requesting quick stop/go. Watching memory RSS, 5xx, tail latency. Deploy tag: r-20260322-v4
Deploy Bot: deploybot: Rollout initiated r-20260322-v4. ap-south(8%), us-west(4%). Autoscaler warmup enabled. Fallback snapshot v3.9.12 created.
Priya Desai: copied. I'll attach a Canary Heap profile and per-host RSS graph.
Jordan Lee: quick smoke: ap-south median latency OK, but one host shows increasing RSS from 1.2GB -> 2.8GB in 6m. No 5xx yet.
Infra Oncall: rule: pause if any host >2.5GB for >4m or 5xx >1% sustained. I'll stand by and mark the host for investigation.
Sasha Ivanov: hold traffic increases. @Deploy Bot pin fallback and pause automatic ramps.
Deploy Bot: deploybot: Automatic ramps paused. Fallback v3.9.12 pinned. Notifying infra and product.
Priya Desai: starting heap dump collection on the suspect host. Can copy dump to /tmp/heapdumps/r-20260322-host42.hprof
QA Lead: running regression smoke suite on canary endpoints now.
Jordan Lee: heap dump suggests a leak in the batcher when request concurrency >8 with long-stream responses. Suspect commit: 7a9c3f5 (streaming patch).
Sasha Ivanov: decision: stay paused for up to 45m while infra and devs confirm. If any host crosses 3GB or 5xx spikes >2% rollback immediately. Ops to coordinate.
Infra Oncall: I've isolated host42 and drained new connections. We'll spin a replacement once patch lands.
Priya Desai: small hotfix branch created to guard batcher allocations and reset buffers after stream close. Pushing build v4.0.1-hotfix.
Deploy Bot: deploybot: hotfix v4.0.1-hotfix built and queued for canary replace. CI: pass.
Jordan Lee: QA smoke against hotfix looks green so far (35/35). Memory on replacement host stable at ~1.1GB.
QA Lead: regression suite full pass on canary endpoints (200/200). No 5xx.
Sasha Ivanov: good. @Deploy Bot proceed to replace canary hosts with hotfix, keep traffic at current percentages, monitor for 10m.
Deploy Bot: deploybot: Replaced canary hosts with v4.0.1-hotfix for r-20260322-v4. Traffic percentages unchanged. Scheduled 10m stability watch.
Infra Oncall: replacement host healthy. No further RSS increases.
Jordan Lee: 10m check done: memory stable, no 5xx, tail latency unchanged.
Sasha Ivanov: OK to ramp per plan: ap-south -> 30% after 10m, us-west -> 15% after 20m if healthy. Documenting stop/go here.
Priya Desai: pushing release notes update: note about batcher guard and recommendation to monitor stream concurrency. Link: https://confluence.redwood/release/v4-0-1-hotfix
Deploy Bot: deploybot: Scheduled bumps queued. Will respect pause signal.
QA Lead: final: thumbs up from QA. Will keep regression harness running for two hours post-rollout.
Sasha Ivanov: thanks all. If any threshold breached we flip rollback. Thread preserved as official stop/go record.
